purpose: Independent mechanics reference matrix for F91. These references are intentionally separate from the production BattleEngine helpers and from the pinned PvPoke implementation.

claims: The first unshielded incoming Charged Attack is reduced to shield-like 1 HP damage and changes Mimikyu to Busted Form.
Using a normal Protect Shield preserves Disguise.
Busted Form carries a persistent -1 Defense stage.
Any Charged Attack changes Shield -> Blade before Charged damage is calculated.
Using a Protect Shield changes Blade -> Shield after shielding.
Shield Fast Moves resolve at minimum 1 damage and +6 energy; Blade restores ordinary Fast Move values.
Switching resets Aegislash to Shield Forme; this remains outside the current 1v1 engine.
Morpeko changes form each time it uses a Charged Attack.
Full Belly uses Electric Aura Wheel; Hangry uses Dark Aura Wheel.
Aura Wheel raises the user's Attack by one stage.
Surf or Dive loads Gulping above 50% HP and Gorging at or below 50% HP.
An unshielded incoming Charged Attack triggers Gulp Missile and returns Cramorant to base form.
Gulping deals 15% max-HP damage and lowers opponent Defense by one stage.
Gorging deals 15% max-HP damage and lowers opponent Attack by two stages.
Protect Shield prevents the retaliation; retaliation can still trigger through the Charged Attack KO.
